items.name: Zenith Woven Long-Sleeve Knit Polo
items.description:
Achieve a look of effortless sophistication with the Stone Taupe Zenith Knit Polo. This sweater is constructed with an intricate, breathable ottoman-style weave that provides both visual texture and substantial comfort. Its natural, muted color is incredibly versatile and features your subtle black bamboo logo, giving this piece a refined, upscale finish perfect for seasonal layering or a polished weekend outing.

Technical Details

  • Custom Detail: Black logo embroidery on the left chest.

  • Fabric Composition: 55% Supima Cotton, 35% Modal, 10% Linen Blend.

  • Knit: Textured ottoman stitch for depth and airflow.

  • Collar: Self-fabric collar with clean, untipped edges.

  • Care: Hand wash or machine wash cold on delicate cycle. Lay flat on a towel to dry. Iron low if necessary.

  • SKU: ZN-KPL-ST488

items.name: Forest Bloom Swim Shorts
items.description:
Step into the deep tropics with the Forest Bloom Swim Short. This captivating print features an array of stylized leaves and botanical shapes in rich, earthy tones like forest green, deep teal, and burgundy. Set against a backdrop that hints at the deep undergrowth, these trunks offer a sophisticated and dynamic pattern perfect for exotic destinations. Crafted from our signature quick-dry fabric, they ensure maximum comfort and effortless style whether you're relaxing by a hidden lagoon or enjoying a seaside lunch.

Technical Details

  • Fabric Composition: 100% Recycled Quick-Dry Polyester.

  • Print: Intricate "Forest Bloom" botanical foliage print.

  • Fit: 6-inch inseam; modern tailored fit for a comfortable, mid-thigh length.

  • Waistband: Elasticized waistband with a contrasting adjustable drawstring.

  • Features: Side-entry pockets and a secure rear pocket with drainage.

  • Lining: Soft and supportive mesh liner.

  • Care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle. Hang dry recommended.

  • SKU: RP-SW-FB88

items.name: Tidal Weave Swimsuit
items.description:
Capture the spirit of the tropics with the Lagoon Breeze Tidal Weave Swimsuit. This stunning light blue color evokes crystal-clear ocean waters, making a vibrant statement at the pool or beach. Made from high-performance, quick-dry fabric, these swimming trunks feature a subtle textural weave that ensures you stay comfortable and look sharp as you move from swimming to sunbathing.

Technical Details

  • Custom Detail: Embroidered black bamboo logo on the lower left leg.

  • Fabric Composition: 100% Recycled Performance Polyester.

  • Weave: Lightweight, textured basketweave provides excellent quick-dry properties and comfort.

  • Fit: 6-inch inseam; tailored, mid-thigh length.

  • Features: Full elastic waistband with an adjustable drawstring, reliable side seam pockets, and a rear patch pocket with a drainage grommet.

  • Lining: Soft and supportive internal mesh brief lining.

  • UV Protection: UPF 50+ sun protection built into the fabric.

  • Care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle. Hang dry recommended.

  • SKU: TS-SW-LB85

items.name: The Maldivian Sunset Beach Tote
items.description:
Embrace the breathtaking beauty of the tropics with the Maldivian Sunset Beach Tote, a masterwork of color and craftsmanship exclusive to Red Panda Resorts.

Inspired by the deep cerulean ocean, the fiery Maldivian sunsets, and the rich foliage of the islands, this generously sized tote features a complex, eye-catching chevron weave. The blend of fuchsia, orange, sapphire, and burgundy ribbons transforms a practical beach bag into a luxurious, wearable piece of art.

The sturdy construction is perfect for carrying all your resort essentials, from towels and snorkeling gear to magazines and sun-care products. The reinforced, woven rope handles offer comfortable carrying, while the subtle placement of our signature Red Panda logo near the rim signifies an unparalleled touch of luxury. This tote is not just an accessory; it's a vibrant souvenir of your unforgettable stay.

items.name: The Maldivian Sanctuary Fragrance Set
items.description:
Immerse yourself in the scent of paradise.

The Maldivian Sanctuary Set is the ultimate sensory expression of the Red Panda Resorts experience. This curated pairing brings together our signature hand-poured candle and our artisanal reed diffuser, both encased in our bespoke, deep-emerald glass vessels. Designed to mimic the vibrant hues of a hidden island lagoon, this set creates an atmosphere of continuous, layered luxury.

The Experience: While the Emerald Atoll Candle provides a warm, flickering glow and the gentle crackle of a wooden wick for your evening wind-down, the Reed Diffuser ensures your space is subtly perfumed throughout the day with notes of sun-drenched flora and salty ocean mist.

The Fragrance Journey:

  • Top: Sparkling Bergamot and Zesty Kaffir Lime.

  • Heart: Velvety Gardenia and Fresh-Cut Palm Fronds.

  • Base: Coastal Amber and a whisper of Sandalwood.

items.name: The Maldivian Tapestry Beach Tote
items.description:
Embrace the breathtaking beauty of the tropics with the Maldivian Tapestry Beach Tote, a masterwork of color and craftsmanship exclusive to Red Panda Resorts.

Inspired by the deep cerulean ocean, the fiery Maldivian sunsets, and the rich foliage of the islands, this generously sized tote features a complex, eye-catching chevron weave. The blend of fuchsia, turquoise, sapphire, and burgundy ribbons transforms a practical beach bag into a luxurious, wearable piece of art.

The reinforced, woven rope handles offer comfortable carrying, while the subtle placement of our signature Red Panda logo near the rim signifies an unparalleled touch of luxury. items.name: The Lagoon Breeze Cabana Towel
items.description:
Wrap yourself in pure luxury after a dip in the Maldivian sea with the Azure Tide Cabana Towel by Red Panda Resorts.

This premium, oversized towel features a crisp, sophisticated design with bold stripes in deep lagoon breeze and calming seafoam green, perfectly mirroring the mesmerizing colors of the Indian Ocean and the lush scenery around your overwater villa. Crafted from ultra-soft, highly absorbent cotton, this towel provides the plush comfort expected of a five-star resort experience.

A final, elegant touch of branding is embroidered at the hem: the flowing cursive of "Red Panda Resorts" followed by our signature Red Panda logo, a subtle reminder of your exclusive tropical escape. It's the ultimate essential for your sun lounger, infinity pool, or private beach day.

The quick-drying, high-performance fabric features a subtle woven texture, ensuring a seamless and stylish transition from the water to the beach bar or boardwalk.

items.name: Bamboo Weave Long-Sleeve Resort Polo
items.description:
Discover versatile comfort with our Midnight Tide Bamboo Weave Resort Polo. This shade captures the natural, earthy tones of the original fabric, highlighted by a subtle texture and clean, tonal trim. The unique weave offers exceptional breathability and softness. Featuring your signature black bamboo logo embroidered on the chest, this sweater polo delivers a polished look perfect for any season.

Key Features & Technology

  • Signature Logo: Custom black bamboo logo embroidered on the left chest.

  • Fabric Blend: 60% Cotton, 30% Bamboo Viscose, 10% Recycled Polyester.

  • Weave Comfort: Textured, breathable knit for a refined feel.

  • Tonal Trim: Clean, matching trim on the collar and placket.

  • Care Instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors, gentle cycle. Non-chlorine bleach only. Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry for best results. Cool iron if needed.

  • Style Number: BWT42488-DS

items.name: Zenith Woven Long-Sleeve Knit Polo Base
items.description:

The dark, luxurious hue provides a striking contrast for the subtle black bamboo logo, making it an essential piece for sharp business-casual or sophisticated evening wear.

  • Fabric Composition: 55% Supima Cotton, 35% Modal, 10% Linen Blend.

  • Care: Hand wash or machine wash cold on delicate cycle. Lay flat on a towel to dry. Iron low if necessary.

  • SKU: ZN-KPL-MT488

testimonial_section.heading: Loved by Travelers Around the World
testimonial_section.subheading:
From romantic getaways to unforgettable family vacations, our guests
share the experiences that made their stay truely special.

testimonial.experience: "This was our first family trip to the Maldives, and Red Panda Resort made it unforgettable. Our children loved the beach activities while we enjoyed moments of peace at the spa. Every detail was thoughtfully planned."
testimonial.name: The Patel Family

testimonial.experience: "Our stay at Red Panda Resort was everything we had dreamed of and more. Waking up to endless ocean views, enjoying private sunset cruises, and dining under the stars made every day feel magical. The warmth of the staff made us feel truly at home."
testimonial.name: Sophia & Daniel

testimonial.experience: "The overwater spa was pure serenity. Every treatment was relaxing, and the peaceful surroundings made it the perfect place to disconnect and recharge."
testimonial.name: Sarah Kim

testimonial.experience: "From snorkeling with sea turtles to jet skiing across turquoise waters, every adventure was unforgettable. The resort perfectly balances luxury with exciting experiences."
testimonial.name: Oliver & Emma Green

testimonial.experience: "Every meal felt like a celebration. The beachfront dining, fresh seafood, and incredible sunsets created memories we'll treasure forever."
testimonial.name: Michael & Ava Carter

testimonial.experience: "Our overwater villa was a sanctuary. Waking up to endless ocean views and stepping straight into the lagoon every morning was pure luxury."
testimonial.name: Emma Wilson

testimonial.experience: "We booked a long weekend with friends, and every day felt like a celebration. Sunset cruises, live music, and unforgettable evenings made it an incredible trip."
testimonial.name: James & Friends

testimonial.experience: "The dive team introduced us to breathtaking coral reefs and incredible marine life. It was one of the best diving experiences we've ever had."
testimonial.name: Lucas Ferreira
